newsitem.title: UK: Kwik Save to move into own-label market-FT.
newsitem.headline: Kwik Save to move into own-label market-FT.

text.p: Kwik Save, the UK discount supermarkets group, is planning to enter the lucrative own-label market, the Financial Times newspaper said.

A strategic review has concluded that Kwik Save should not abandon its niche as a discounter of branded goods, but that it could add value by launching an own-label brand, which would be cheaper than those offered by the leading supermarket chains, the newspaper said.
Kwik Save publishes its annual results on Thursday.
Analysts contacted by Reuters last week said that the review may also conclude that Kwik Save should close between 100-300 unprofitable stores and even consider a change of name.
Exceptional charges could total anywhere between 60-100 million stg. Year pre-tax pre-exceptional profits are expected to slump to 82.0 to 90.0 million stg from 125.5 million.
